tools.name: trigger_scan
tools.description: Scan trends for a product and stage candidate seeds (level 1 of the pipeline).

tools.name: list_seeds
tools.description: List the most recently scanned seeds for a product.

tools.name: expand_seeds
tools.description: Expand selected seeds into content opportunities (level 2 of the pipeline).

tools.name: list_opportunities
tools.description: List staged content opportunities for a product.

tools.name: delete_opportunities
tools.description: Delete staged opportunities that shouldn't be generated.

tools.name: generate_content
tools.description: Generate draft articles for selected opportunities (seo_intent or reward_intent, per the product's pipeline_type).

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: List staged article drafts for a product (unpublished by default).

tools.name: publish_content
tools.description: Publish drafts to the product's configured publish destination(s) (webhook and/or a connected X account).

tools.name: index_content
tools.description: Submit published URLs to Google Search Console for indexing.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Check the status/result of a background pipeline job (scan, expand, generate, publish, index all run as jobs).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "content-pipeline-agent" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: index_content · Public sink: publish_content, index_content, get_job_status · Destructive: delete_opportunities, get_job_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: index_content · Public sink: publish_content, index_content, get_job_status · Destructive: delete_opportunities, get_job_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
